how.title: How it works
how.step1: 1. Weigh a sample of known size. Divide its weight by its units to get the weight of one unit. Example: {w} g / {n} = {u} g.
how.step2: 2. Divide each weighing by the weight of one unit. Example: {w} g gives {q} units.
how.step3: 3. Add the sealed packs, the units counted by hand and the sample. Example: {q} + 7×{p} + {s} = {total}.
how.step4: 4. Only the final total is rounded, never the parts.
how.marginText: The margin applies only to the weighed part. Sealed packs, hand counts and the sample are exact. It combines the scale resolution with a minimum of 1% for natural variation between copies (paper, humidity, print run), and the larger of the two is shown, rounded up.
how.sampleText: Use at least 10 units, and a sample weight of at least 200 times the scale resolution. If the sample falls short, the app suggests how many units to use but does not block you. Very light leaflets only need more units.
